description: This file declares the SystemTime class, which handles system time management, event subscription, and timezone parsing within the WPEFramework plugin context. It defines methods for checking system time availability, retrieving timezone offsets, and processing related events.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: Manages system time, timezone, and related events within the plugin, providing interfaces to check time availability and obtain timezone offsets.

methods.name: SystemTime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SystemTime instance with a reference to the shell interface.

methods.name: IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the system time source is available.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone offset in seconds.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses timezone string and accuracy, returning a pair of accuracy enum and offset.

methods.name: CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Establishes a system link, likely for IPC or RPC.

methods.name: SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to system time and timezone change events.

methods.name: UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Updates the internal indicator of system time availability.

methods.name: UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Updates timezone information and transition maps.

methods.name: EventLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing events related to system time and timezone changes.
